4298.description_text: Benefits: Introducing ProHealth Longevity's Vitamin B12, a unique combination crafted to harness the synergistic benefits of multiple forms of Vitamin B12. This innovative formula incorporates methylcobalamin, dibencozide, cyanocobalamin, and hydroxycobalamin, each selected for their unique contributions to cellular health, energy metabolism, and overall longevity. While many B12 supplements focus solely on one form of B12, ProHealth Longevity's Vitamin B12 embraces a comprehensive approach, recognizing the diverse roles and benefits offered by each variant. From supporting brain function to enhancing energy levels and combating age-related declines, our formula is designed to optimize B12 status and promote vitality at every stage of life. Plays a crucial role in maintaining cellular integrity by aiding in DNA synthesis and repair Acts as a cofactor in the conversion of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins into usable energy Supports healthy brain aging by aiding in the regeneration of myelin, the protective sheath around nerve fibers Provides mood support by serving as a cofactor in the synthesis of neurotransmitters View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Enhances cellular health. Vitamin B12 is a pivotal player in the synthesis and repair of DNA, critical processes that safeguard cellular integrity. Research has linked Vitamin B12 deficiency to disruptions in DNA synthesis and repair mechanisms, underscoring its importance in maintaining genetic stability. (1) Vitamin B12 offers further cellular protection by supporting telomere maintenance, the protective caps at the ends of chromosomes. Telomeres play a vital role in preserving DNA integrity during cell division, and their maintenance is closely linked to longevity and overall health. By supporting telomere integrity and DNA repair mechanisms, Vitamin B12 contributes to enhanced cellular resilience and longevity, offering comprehensive support for optimal aging. Heathy heart aging: Vitamin B12 aids in the reduction of homocysteine levels, an amino acid implicated in various forms of DNA damage, including DNA strand breaks. Elevated homocysteine is associated with accelerated cardiovascular aging and increased risk of cardiovascular events. (2) Research shows that increasing vitamin B12 intake may reduce homocysteine levels up to 7%. (3) Promotes energy production. Vitamin B12 is indispensable for sustaining energy levels, with its deficiency linked to reduced energy production in the body. Through its involvement in synthesizing SAMe, a vital methyl donor nutrient, Vitamin B12 supports mitochondrial function and the generation of ATP, the primary energy currency of cells. As we age, ATP production tends to decline, exacerbated by decreasing levels of Vitamin B12. This decline can lead to age-related fatigue and diminished stamina. Supplementation with Vitamin B12 may offer a solution by replenishing stores and potentially mitigating the decline in ATP production associated with aging. Promotes Cognitive Health. Vitamin B12 plays a crucial role in maintaining cognitive function, and its deficiency is strongly associated with cognitive decline and memory impairment. (4) Its diverse functions in methylation, neurotransmitter synthesis, and mitochondrial activity are essential for optimal brain health. Notably, Vitamin B12 shows promise in mitigating age-related neurodegeneration by regulating inflammatory processes and protecting against the formation of amyloid beta (Aβ) plaque. (5) Supplementation with Vitamin B12 has potential to alleviate symptoms linked to accelerated brain aging and support overall cognitive well-being. Supports Mood. Vitamin B12 plays a vital role in the synthesis of essential mood-regulating neurotransmitters, including serotonin and dopamine. Serotonin, known as the "feel-good" neurotransmitter, is synthesized from the amino acid tryptophan in a process facilitated by SAMe, which in turn relies on sufficient levels of Vitamin B12 for optimal function. It helps decide which parts of your DNA stay quiet and which stay active, helping cells adapt to stress, maintain energy efficiency, and resist the effects of aging. Commonly known as the "longevity switch," SIRT1 is involved in DNA repair, the removal of damaged cellular components, and the optimization of energy use. As we age, SIRT1 activity naturally declines due to factors such as oxidative stress, poor diet, disrupted sleep, and environmental challenges. This reduction is linked to diminished cellular resilience and many of the classic signs of aging. The good news is that certain food compounds can help support SIRT1 function. Plant-derived polyphenols such as resveratrol (from red grapes) and pterostilbene (from blueberries) are among the best-studied for their ability to activate SIRT1 and promote healthy cellular aging. These compounds mimic calorie restriction at the molecular level, helping to reactivate SIRT1 and restore youthful gene expression patterns. By boosting SIRT1 activity, they help shift cells into a protective, repair-focused state, supporting the body’s natural defenses as we age.*1-7 Why Resveratrol + Pterostilbene Work Better Together Resveratrol is well-known for supporting SIRT1, but the body clears it fast. The liver converts most of it into inactive metabolites within minutes. Blood levels fall quickly, so only a limited amount reaches cells. The effect on SIRT1 is meaningful, yet short-lived.*1-3,5-7 Pterostilbene shifts the profile. It is a close relative of resveratrol with two methyl groups that improve its performance. Up to 4× higher oral bioavailability* Greater lipophilicity for superior cellular penetration* Significantly longer half-life in the body (up to 7× longer than resveratrol)*4,14-16 When used together in a balanced ratio, the two ingredients work in sequence. Resveratrol supports a fast SIRT1 response. Pterostilbene keeps that response active for a longer period due to its greater stability. This provides steadier sirtuin pathway support than resveratrol alone.*1-7,14-16 What Makes Ours Better? 4:1 Polyphenol Complex: Balanced to reflect bioavailability differences between resveratrol and pterostilbene. Clinically Studied Forms: Includes the active trans form of resveratrol and pterostilbene for consistency and purity. Triple Lab Tested: Verified three times by independent labs for purity and potency. Full Transparency: Third-party test results published online for complete confidence. But as early as your 20s, collagen production begins to decline, dropping 1–1.5% per year.*1 By your 40s, this results in visible and structural changes: skin loses firmness, joints feel weaker, and connective tissues become less resilient.*1,9,10 To build collagen, your body relies on three key amino acids—glycine, proline, and hydroxyproline—arranged in a tightly wound triple helix. Of these, hydroxyproline plays the most critical role.7,8 Meet Hydroxyproline—The Master Collagen Signal Hydroxyproline is a rare and highly specialized amino acid found only in collagen. It plays a critical role in giving collagen its unique triple-helix shape—the very structure that allows collagen to be strong, stable, and resilient.7,8 But hydroxyproline does more than build collagen—it activates it.*2,4,12-14 When collagen begins to break down (like after exercise or with age), hydroxyproline is released into the bloodstream. This acts as a biological signal that alerts your body to ramp up new collagen production. In this way, hydroxyproline serves as the body’s built-in collagen switch, helping to restore and rebuild what’s been lost.*2,4,12-14 By supplementing with hydroxyproline directly, you give your body the raw material—and the signal—it needs to boost collagen production as you age.*1-4 Beyond Hydroxyproline: Complete Collagen Activation Hydroxyproline is essential—but it’s not the whole story. Your body can also create its own hydroxyproline by converting the amino acid proline—a reaction that depends on vitamin C. That’s why Pro Collagen Activator delivers: Hydroxyproline to directly activate collagen synthesis*2,4,12-14 Proline to support natural hydroxyproline formation*2,6,12,16 Liposomal Vitamin C to enhance proline conversion and collagen stability*15 Citrus Bioflavonoids to boost vitamin C absorption and help protect collagen*15 This systems-level approach helps fuel collagen production from multiple angles—so your body has what it needs to build and sustain strong, healthy tissue.*2,4,6,12-16 What Sets Us Apart No Animal Ingredients: Made without animal-derived collagen or byproducts. High-Dose Hydroxyproline: Equivalent to 5 grams of collagen peptides per serving. Flexible + Stackable: Powerful enough to stand alone, or stack with collagen peptides for amplified results.* Smarter Support: Features a small-molecule formula designed for superior absorption and optimal activation.* Rooted in Science: Formulated to activate the body’s own collagen switch.* The ProHealth Difference Doctor-Formulated: Developed by our in-house science team in collaboration with leading wellness experts to address the root causes of aging.* Triple Lab Tested: Rigorously tested three times by independent third-party labs to guarantee unmatched potency and purity. Full Transparency: In an industry full of misleading claims, we publish our third-party lab results—so you always know exactly what’s in every bottle. Manufactured in the USA: Since 1988, we’ve proudly produced our supplements in FDA-regulated, GMP-certified facilities, ensuring the highest quality and safety standards. 100-Day Risk-Free Guarantee: We stand behind our products. If you’re not completely satisfied, contact our Santa Barbara, CA office for a full refund—no hassle, no questions asked. A Smarter Way to Age Well Pro Collagen Activator is designed to help restore what time naturally diminishes—by reactivating your body’s own collagen-building systems with precision. This advanced formula delivers hydroxyproline in a highly bioavailable form, combined with proline, liposomal vitamin C, and citrus bioflavonoids to fuel collagen production from multiple angles.*2,4,6,12-16 The result is a comprehensive, inside-out approach to structural renewal—supporting the skin, joints, and full-body resilience at every stage of life.*1-6 Whether your goal is to boost skin health, maintain connective tissue strength, or support graceful aging, Pro Collagen Activator offers a smarter, science-driven way to keep your collagen engine running strong.*1-6 A Word from Our Chief Science Officer “Hydroxyproline is unique to collagen—and the body is remarkably attuned to it. When collagen breaks down from age, stress, or daily wear and tear, hydroxyproline is released into the bloodstream as a biological distress signal. The body interprets this as a cue to initiate repair. By supplementing with hydroxyproline, we harness this natural signaling pathway—essentially tricking the body into ramping up collagen production in skin, joints, bones, and connective tissue. It’s like flipping your body’s collagen switch back on.” Pioneering Longevity Since 1988 For over 36 years, ProHealth has been dedicated to crafting the world’s highest-quality supplements—rooted in innovation, integrity, and a passion for healthy aging. With a long-standing A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau, our reputation for purity and potency has made us one of the most trusted names in the industry. Our commitment to scientific rigor, premium sourcing, and results you can feel continues to drive everything we do. 4303.description_text: Finally, NMN and NR Together NMN and NR elevate NAD+ through complementary pathways*1,2 Powers cellular energy to support brain, heart, and whole-body vitality*3-5 Enhances mitochondrial performance and resilience with age*3-5 Includes TMG to support balanced methylation*6 Addresses key drivers of healthy aging*2,7 View Certificate of Analysis The Next Evolution in NAD+ Science NMNR™ Pro Synergy unites NMN and NR in one advanced formula designed to restore and sustain cellular NAD+ levels. This dual-precursor approach fuels energy production, supports DNA repair, and promotes cellular revitalization. With added TMG to maintain methylation balance, the formula delivers comprehensive, long-term support for healthy aging and vitality.*1-7 How It Works This formula is designed to help restore NAD+ through three complementary mechanisms. NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide) NMN is an immediate precursor to NAD+ that bypasses early rate-limiting steps in the salvage pathway. It supports rapid increases in intracellular NAD+, helping energize mitochondria and activate sirtuin enzymes involved in cellular repair and longevity.*3,4 NR (Nicotinamide Riboside)NR complements NMN by supporting systemic NAD+ synthesis through distinct transport and conversion pathways. Hydrogen malate enhances NR bioavailability and provides malic acid, a key component of the Krebs energy cycle.*2,8 Trimethylglycine (TMG) TMG provides methyl groups needed to recycle homocysteine into methionine, supporting balanced methylation and maintaining NAD+ homeostasis. It also protects against the potential depletion of methyl donors during NAD+ synthesis from NMN and NR.*6 Together, these clinically studied ingredients help restore healthy NAD+ levels and strengthen the body’s natural capacity for energy, repair, and resilience.*1-5 Why NAD+ Matters Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD) is a vital coenzyme present in every cell, essential for creating and maintaining energy throughout the body. Each human cell contains hundreds of millions of NAD+ molecules that power metabolism, drive DNA repair, and activate key enzymes like PARPs and sirtuins, which sustain cellular integrity, stress resilience, and healthy aging.9,10 As we age, NAD+ levels naturally decline. This reduction diminishes mitochondrial energy production and weakens the activity of sirtuins, PARPs, and AMPK, leaving cells more susceptible to damage. The decline is further accelerated by increased CD38 activity — an enzyme that degrades NAD+ and disrupts energy balance.9,10 Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors such as NMN and NR, complemented by TMG for methylation support, helps sustain cellular energy production and preserve healthy NAD+ metabolism over time.*6,9,10 What Makes Ours Better? Dual-Pathway NAD+ Support: Combines NMN and NR to enhance both intracellular and systemic NAD+ synthesis.*1,2 Methylation-Enhanced: Includes 300 mg TMG per serving to maintain methylation balance and support healthy clearance of NAD+ metabolites.*6 Targeted Liver Support: Supplies key nutrients that drive hepatic detoxification and help restore balance.* Clinically Supported Dosing: Delivers 1000 mg of NAD+ precursors per serving, reflecting levels used in human studies demonstrating improvements in cellular and metabolic function.*3-5 Synergistic Design: Developed to activate multiple longevity mechanisms — from NAD+ synthesis and recycling to sirtuin and AMPK activation.*10 The ProHealth Difference Doctor-Formulated: Developed by our in-house science team in collaboration with leading wellness experts. Triple Lab Tested: Verified three times by independent labs for purity and potency. Full Transparency: Third-party test results published online for complete confidence. USA Manufactured: Proudly manufactured in the USA in FDA-registered, GMP-certified facilities since 1988. 100-Day Risk-Free Guarantee: If you’re not fully satisfied, we’ll refund your purchase in full. A Word from our Chief Science Officer "People tend to fall into camp NMN or camp NR. But why not do both? These two forms of vitamin B3 act at different points in the NAD+ pathway, working together to sustain NAD+ levels across multiple tissues. Used in combination, they provide broader support for the entire NAD+ metabolome." Glutathione Triple Boost was designed to restore balance through a coordinated three-step system:12,13 Direct Replenishment — Opitac™ L-Glutathione (Reduced) This stable, bioavailable form of glutathione supplies the body’s master antioxidant directly. Each time the body detoxifies a compound, metabolizes alcohol, or counters oxidative stress from exercise or pollution, glutathione is used up. Together, they drive three essential pathways of healthy aging: NAD+ production, methylation balance, and sirtuin activation. This synergistic design helps maximize the benefits of NAD+ across your entire body.*1-9,12-17 Why It Works There’s a reason this formula has been a best-seller since its launch—and why many of the most respected names in longevity science rely on this specific combination. This becomes especially problematic after age 50, when nutrient absorption declines, methylation slows, and your body’s demand for B vitamins increases. B vitamins are water-soluble and quickly excreted in urine, making it difficult to maintain adequate levels. Absorption also declines naturally with age, and more than 30% of adults over 60 are estimated to have suboptimal levels of vitamin B12. Up to 18% may also be low in thiamine—two of the most critical B vitamins for neurological and metabolic health.*1,6 This creates the perfect storm: your need for B vitamins increases, but your body’s ability to absorb and utilize them declines. 4323.description_text: Helps combat aging, improves heart health and promotes muscle strength NMN supplementation has been found to improve various parameters of health, including physical endurance and muscle strength, neurological function, heart health, body weight and gene expression. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is a derivative of the B-vitamin niacin that dramatically improves health and longevity by serving as a precursor to NAD+. NMN Pro Powder allows NMN to be absorbed directly into the blood vessels in the mouth and under the tongue, which increases the product's bioavailability. In this way, NMN avoids digestion in the gastrointestinal tract and can be more rapidly delivered into the bloodstream. View Certificate of Analysis » Supports Longevity. Studies have shown that boosting NAD+ synthesis in the body extends the lifespan of yeast, worms and flies. (1) Blood Sugar Regulation. As we age, we have more trouble processing glucose, leading to higher blood sugar. Supplemental NMN is shown to improve several markers of skeletal muscle glucose metabolism that are commonly dysregulated in people with metabolic disorders. (2) Supports Metabolism and Healthy Weight. Although excessive body weight can develop at any age, adults over age 40 are particularly susceptible to age-related weight gain as metabolism slows down and body composition is altered to favor fat over lean muscle. As obese individuals have reductions in both NAD+ levels and ATP (energy) production, replenishing NAD+ through NMN can help to reverse this while improving metabolic pathways to maintain a healthy weight. (3,4,5) Supports Healthy Cognition: Declining cognitive function with age is related to a reduced NAD+ levels that impair mitochondrial function. Replenishing NAD+ stores through NMN may be able to prevent this dysfunction. (6,7) Supports Healthy Skin: In our 30s and 40s, the appearance of our skin can start to show signs of age. Several studies have examined how boosting NAD+ levels in the skin prevents premature skin aging or supports a healthier external appearance. (8,9) References: 1. 4326.description_text: Combat Aging, Improve Heart Health and Promote Muscle Strength NMN supplementation has been found to improve various parameters of health, including physical endurance and muscle strength, neurological function, heart health, body weight and gene expression. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is a derivative of the B-vitamin niacin that dramatically improves health and longevity by serving as a precursor to NAD+. NMN Pro 250 Sustained Release is designed to slow and prolong NMN absorption, allowing a longer steady blood level concentration of the active ingredient. This enables NMN Pro 250 Sustained Release to be given at higher doses less frequently. View Certificate of Analysis Research Supported Benefits: Supports Longevity. Studies have shown that boosting NAD+ synthesis in the body extends the lifespan of yeast, worms and flies. (1) Blood Sugar Regulation. As we age, we have more trouble processing glucose, leading to higher blood sugar. Supplemental NMN is shown to improve several markers of skeletal muscle glucose metabolism that are commonly dysregulated in people with metabolic disorders. (2) Supports Metabolism and Healthy Weight. Although excessive body weight can develop at any age, adults over age 40 are particularly susceptible to age-related weight gain as metabolism slows down and body composition is altered to favor fat over lean muscle. As obese individuals have reductions in both NAD+ levels and ATP (energy) production, replenishing NAD+ through NMN can help to reverse this while improving metabolic pathways to maintain a healthy weight. (3,4,5) Supports Healthy Cognition. Declining cognitive function with age is related to a reduced NAD+ levels that impair mitochondrial function. Replenishing NAD+ stores through NMN may be able to prevent this dysfunction. (6,7) Supports Healthy Skin. In our 30s and 40s, the appearance of our skin can start to show signs of age. 4332.description_text: Helps combat aging, supports heart health and promotes muscle strength and cognition NMN supplementation has been found to improve various parameters of health, including physical endurance and muscle strength, neurological function, heart health and body weight. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is a derivative of the B-vitamin niacin that may improves health and longevity by serving as a precursor to NAD+. Liposomal form of NMN allows for increased bioavailability and enhanced absorption. Liposomal NMN Pro Complete is the first and only perfectly balanced combination of liposomal NMN, Trans-Resveratrol and TMG on the market. Instead of having to take three separate supplements each day, you can now get the ideal balance of all three in one convenient serving. View Certificate of Analysis » Research-Supported Benefits: Supports Longevity. Studies have shown that boosting NAD+ synthesis in the body extends the lifespan of yeast, worms and flies. (1)Blood Sugar Regulation. As we age, we have more trouble processing glucose, leading to higher blood sugar—a known contributor to several metabolic-related disorders. Supplemental NMN has been shown to improve several markers of skeletal muscle glucose metabolism that are commonly dysregulated in people with metabolic disorders. (2)Supports Metabolism and Healthy Weight. Although excessive body weight can develop at any age, adults over age 40 are particularly susceptible to age-related weight gain as metabolism slows down and body composition is altered to favor fat over lean muscle. As obese individuals have reductions in both NAD+ levels and ATP (energy) production, replenishing NAD+ through NMN can help to reverse this while improving metabolic pathways to maintain a healthy weight. (3,4,5)Supports Healthy Cognition: With increasing age, adults experience declining cognitive function, which is often caused by low NAD+ levels and impaired mitochondrial function. Replenishing NAD+ stores through NMN may be able to prevent this dysfunction. (6,7,8,9)Supports Healthy Skin: In our 30s and 40s, the appearance of our skin can start to show signs of age. 4338.description_text: Helps combat aging, improves heart health and promotes muscle strength NMN supplementation has been found to improve various parameters of health, including physical endurance and muscle strength, neurological function, heart health, body weight and gene expression. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is a derivative of the B-vitamin niacin that dramatically improves health and longevity by serving as a precursor to NAD+. NMN Pro Powder allows NMN to be absorbed directly into the blood vessels in the mouth and under the tongue, which increases the product's bioavailability. In this way, NMN avoids digestion in the gastrointestinal tract and can be more rapidly delivered into the bloodstream. View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Supports Longevity. Studies have shown that boosting NAD+ synthesis in the body extends the lifespan of yeast, worms and flies.1 Blood Sugar Regulation. As we age, we have more trouble processing glucose, leading to higher blood sugar. Supplemental NMN is shown to improve several markers of skeletal muscle glucose metabolism that are commonly dysregulated in people with metabolic disorders.2 Supports Metabolism and Healthy Weight. Although excessive body weight can develop at any age, adults over age 40 are particularly susceptible to age-related weight gain as metabolism slows down and body composition is altered to favor fat over lean muscle. As obese individuals have reductions in both NAD+ levels and ATP (energy) production, replenishing NAD+ through NMN can help to reverse this while improving metabolic pathways to maintain a healthy weight.3,4,5 Supports Healthy Cognition: Declining cognitive function with age is related to a reduced NAD+ levels that impair mitochondrial function. Replenishing NAD+ stores through NMN may be able to prevent this dysfunction.6,7 Supports Healthy Skin: In our 30s and 40s, the appearance of our skin can start to show signs of age. Several studies have examined how boosting NAD+ levels in the skin prevents premature skin aging or supports a healthier external appearance.8,9 References: 1. Fang EF, Kassahun H, Croteau DL, et al. 4339.description_text: Buffered vitamin C and citrus bioflavonoids enhance absorption and support a healthy immune system, skin health and cellular health Supports a healthy immune response Supports cellular health Supports skin health Buffered vitamin C is absorbed 400% faster than regular vitamin C and retained by the body for as much as 3x longer View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Supports Immune Health. Vitamin C plays an important role in normal immune function, and maintaining adequate vitamin C status helps support the body’s natural defenses. Supplementation with vitamin C has been shown in research to support immune health and help maintain normal immune responses.1, 2 Supports Cellular Health. Vitamin C is a potent antioxidant that scavenges for free radicals, protecting cells from oxidative stress. Pro-C Complex also contains rose hips, acerola, rutin and citrus bioflavonoids that all act as antioxidants, including hesperidin, eriocitrin, naringin and narirutin.1 Supports Skin Health. Vitamin C is essential for healthy skin, as it is needed for collagen synthesis. Collagen production starts to decline as early as age 25, leading to wrinkles and sagging or thinning skin. Vitamin C also supports skin health through its role as an antioxidant, which helps to protect against UV damage.3 Enhances Iron Absorption. Recent research concluded “Vitamin C is the only dietary constituent other than animal tissue that has been shown to promote iron absorption”. 4 References: 1. Carr AC, Maggini S. Vitamin C and Immune Function. Nutrients. 2017;9(11):1211. Published 2017 Nov 3.doi:10.3390/nu9111211 2. Wintergerst ES, Maggini S, Hornig DH. Immune-enhancing role of vitamin C and zinc and effect on clinical conditions. Ann Nutr Metab. 2006;50(2):85-94. doi:10.1159/000090495 doi:10.1159/000090495 3. Pullar JM, Carr AC, Vissers MCM. The Efficacy and Safety of Vitamin C for Iron Supplementation in Adult Patients With Iron Deficiency Anemia: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Netw Open. 2020;3(11):e2023644. Published 2020 Nov 2. doi:10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2020.23644 Vitamin C is an essential nutrient with powerful antioxidant properties that offers support for immune function. It also aids in wound healing, helps with collagen production and assists in the absorption of iron. Vitamin C also supports cellular health and skin health, including boosting collagen synthesis for healthy skin, bones, cartilage, blood vessels, teeth and gums. ProHealth’s Pro-C Complex™ is formulated using a unique buffered form of vitamin C with metabolites to enhance absorption, along with research-supported ingredients and dosing to address various aspects of health and longevity. Calcium ascorbate neutralizes stomach pH to reduce stomach issues common with high vitamin C dosing. Additionally, calcium ascorbate increases absorption by 400% and remains in the body 3-4 times longer. Acerola powder is a natural source of vitamin C and antioxidants that is more absorbable compared to the synthetic form of ascorbic acid. Rose hips powder is a natural source of vitamin C added to support immune health. It’s also shown to support collagen synthesis and reduce oxidative stress, which is known to contribute to premature aging. Rutin is a powerful antioxidant that supports the body’s use of vitamin C, protects from free radical damage, offers immune system support and increases the production of collagen. The citrus bioflavonoid complex (hesperidin, eriocitrin, naringin, narirutin) work synergistically with vitamin C to neutralize free radicals and complement the antioxidant potency. 4340.description_text: Supports brain, cardiovascular, cellular and joint health Supports brain health and cognitive function Supports cellular and DNA health Supports healthy aging Supports heart and metabolic health View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Supports Brain Health. Research shows that resveratrol, a molecule found in red grapes and wine, may protect the brain from symptoms of brain aging, including improving memory and delaying cognitive decline. The neuroprotective effects of resveratrol come from its sirtuin-activating, inflammation-regulating, mitochondrial-supporting and antioxidant activity. (1-3) Supports Cellular and DNA Health. Resveratrol acts as a potent antioxidant, which reduces harmful oxidative stress. It also activates genes called sirtuins. Healthy sirtuin activity helps to fight cellular senescence, support DNA repair, boost mitochondrial function and generate cellular energy through ATP production. (3,4) Supports Healthy Aging. Resveratrol activates SIRT1, often referred to as the "longevity gene." Healthy older adults tend to have higher levels of SIRT1 activity, and SIRT1 overexpression can increase lifespan in worms and animals. In humans, SIRT1 supports healthy aging and longevity. (5,6) Supports Joint Health. Due to its role in supporting healthier inflammatory responses and modulating oxidative stress, resveratrol has exhibited joint-protective effects. (7) Supports Heart Health. Resveratrol is well-known for its link to supporting cardiovascular health. Research has found that resveratrol benefits endothelial function, blood vessel health and blood pressure by boosting SIRT1 activity, reducing oxidative stress and increasing nitric oxide production. (8,9) Supports Metabolic Health. Resveratrol activates SIRT1, which has been studied for its role in supporting healthier glucose metabolism. People with reduced SIRT1 expression tend to have higher blood sugar, poor glucose control and metabolic disorders. (10) References: 1. Salehi B, Mishra AP, Nigam M, et al. 4346.description_text: Metformin: Prescribed For Longevity A trusted, highly effective medication for lowering blood sugar and promoting a healthy metabolism. A favorite among biohackers and longevity experts for optimizing health and slowing the effects of aging. 3-5 Key Ingredient Metformin: 500mg per tablet. How It Works Metformin targets multiple pathways involved in glucose metabolism, with its primary effects driven by three key mechanisms:1,6-8 Decreasing glucose production in the liver Enhancing your body’s ability to use insulin Slowing glucose absorption in the intestines Health Benefits Combats Sugar Spikes: Minimizes post-meal blood sugar fluctuations, supporting stable glucose levels.1,8 Boosts GLP-1: Activates the "feel full" hormone, aiding in appetite regulation and healthy weight management.6 Enhances Cellular Energy: Targets the mitochondrial respiratory chain, optimizes mitochondrial function, and supports mitochondrial regeneration (mitophagy).9,10 Balances the Gut Microbiome: Promotes a healthy gut environment for improved digestion and systemic well-being.1 Protects Heart and Brain: Supports vascular health and helps safeguard vital organs from age-related decline.12-16 Anti-Aging Benefits Beyond Blood SugarMetformin is increasingly recognized as one of the most promising off-label drugs in the field of aging and longevity science. With nearly 3,000 participants between the ages of 65 and 79, this six-year study is evaluating Metformin’s impact on key age-related factors—including heart health, cognitive function, and cellular vitality. If successful, TAME could make Metformin the first widely used drug to directly target the biology of aging— establishing it as a cornerstone therapy to slow decline and extend healthspan. And the best part? You don’t have to wait for the trial to finish! Metformin is already available by prescription, offering those eligible a forward-thinking option to support long-term health today.4 Key Longevity Pathways Influenced by MetforminRecent studies have identified multiple cellular effects of Metformin that may help explain its beneficial impact on metabolism and age-related health.1,4,6,8-13,19-30 Insulin Regulation IGF-1 Signaling mTOR Inhibition Mitochondrial Function Oxidative Stress Reduction AMPK Activation DNA Damage Reduction Inflammation Modulation Autophagy Activation Cellular Senescence Epigenetic Alteration Microbiome Balance Why Choose ProHealth Longevity? Doctor Review: A licensed medical professional will review your form to confirm eligibility. Expedited Shipping: Prescriptions will be shipped from a US-licensed, FDA-regulated pharmacy. At-Home Support: Receive 24/7 access to our care team through phone, text, or email for personalized guidance every step of the way. Get Started >> FAQS Who should take Metformin?Though traditionally used to manage type 2 diabetes, Metformin is being studied for its potential benefits in healthy aging. People without diabetes—particularly those with insulin resistance, elevated fasting glucose, excess weight, or a family history of metabolic conditions—may want to explore Metformin’s role in longevity with their healthcare provider. How do I take Metformin?Metformin is taken orally once or twice daily, with or after meals, to help reduce stomach upset and improve absorption. Are there any side effects?Metformin has a well-established safety profile, with most side effects being mild. Common side effects include nausea, stomach discomfort, and diarrhea, which often improve over time. More serious side effects are rare but can include severe allergic reactions and lactic acidosis—a buildup of lactic acid in the blood. This risk is higher in people with kidney disease, so doctors typically avoid prescribing metformin in those cases.Additionally, long-term use of Metformin can lead to lower vitamin B12 levels. If your vitamin B12 levels become too low, vitamin B12 supplements can help. Also, some studies indicate that individuals over 65 with low muscle mass may find it more challenging to build muscle while taking Metformin. Are there any special dietary requirements while using Metformin? While there are no specific foods you must include or avoid when taking Metformin, adopting healthy dietary habits can enhance your results. Pairing Metformin with a balanced diet and regular exercise, as recommended by your healthcare provider, is key to achieving your goals. Excessive alcohol consumption increases the risk of lactic acidosis and should be avoided or limited while on metformin. Can Metformin help with weight loss?Yes, metformin has been associated with modest weight loss. It works by reducing appetite, improving insulin sensitivity, and encouraging the body to burn fat more efficiently. However, it’s not a weight loss drug—and it’s most effective when combined with a healthy diet and regular exercise. Results can vary from person to person. 4348.description_text: Nicotinamide riboside (NR), an advanced form of vitamin B3 (niacin), has proven to be one of the most promising supplements to promote longevity and healthy aging. By functioning as an NAD+ precursor, NR has been proven to significantly increase NAD+ levels in the body, thus promoting heart, brain, metabolic, and cellular health. Pterostilbene is a powerful antioxidant compound that has been shown to activate sirtuins (longevity genes), amplifying the longevity-promoting effects of NR. NR + Pterostilbene Supports longevity by increasing NAD+ levels and activating sirtuins Enhances cellular health by promoting DNA repair and reducing oxidative stress Promotes heart health by supporting healthy blood flow Protects the brain from age-related functional decline View Certificate of Analysis » Research-Supported Benefits: Promotes Longevity. Nicotinamide Riboside promotes longevity by increasing levels of NAD+ in the body. NAD+ levels decline with age, contributing to accelerated cellular aging and health decline. Research shows that increasing NAD+ levels in aged animals extends lifespan. (1) Pterostilbene supports longevity by activating sirtuins, which are commonly referred to as "longevity genes". Animal studies show that activating sirtuins extends lifespan and healthspan. (2) Supports Cellular Health. By increasing NAD+ levels, NR aids in facilitating DNA repair. (3) DNA damage is associated with decreased longevity and increased risk for age-related health decline, highlighting the importance of the DNA repair process. Due to its antioxidant potential, pterostilbene offers additional protection for cellular health by reducing oxidative damage, a key contributor to cellular aging. (4) Enhances Heart Health. Research shows that NR enhances heart health by reducing stiffness of the arteries and supporting healthy blood flow. (5) Aortic stiffness contributes to blood pressure dysregulation and increased cardiac risk, making the reduction of aortic stiffness critical to maintaining heart health. Animal studies also show pterostilbene exhibits cardio-protective effects by reducing oxidative stress of heart tissue. (6) Protects Against Cognitive Decline. NAD+ is critical to maintaining mitochondrial health of brain cells. A decline of NAD+ levels research suggests that reduced NAD+ levels contribute to many of the hallmarks of brain aging. By increasing NAD+ levels and aiding in the regulation of inflammatory levels, Nicotinamide Riboside shows promise in supporting healthy brain aging and cognitive function. (7) Pterostilbene further supports healthy brain aging by activating sirt-1 and improving synaptic plasticity, a vital biological process related to memory and learning. (8) References: 1. Apigenin is a naturally occurring flavonoid found in a variety of fruits, vegetables, and herbs. Its therapeutic potential is highlighted by human clinical studies on chamomile extract, which contains apigenin as a key active ingredient. Recognized for its broad-spectrum benefits, apigenin has gained attention for its role in supporting relaxation and sleep quality. It interacts with GABA receptors in the brain, helping to foster a calm state of mind and support healthy sleep patterns—critical factors for long-term health and cognitive function.*31 One of apigenin's key mechanisms involves targeting CD38, an enzyme responsible for depleting NAD+, a vital molecule for energy production and cellular repair. By balancing CD38 activity, apigenin helps maintain healthy NAD+ levels, supporting mitochondrial function, DNA integrity, and overall cellular resilience as the body ages. Additionally, apigenin offers powerful antioxidant effects, neutralizing free radicals and reducing oxidative stress—both major contributors to aging and age-related decline.*1-3 By addressing several hallmarks of aging and supporting the core pillars of health, apigenin emerges as a powerful compound for those aiming to optimize their health and longevity.* Feel the Difference with Full Spectrum Apigenin Helps maintain healthy NAD+ levels*Apigenin indirectly boosts NAD+ levels by targeting CD38, a glycoprotein that consumes NAD+ during cellular processes. Research shows that mice either lacking CD38 or supplemented with apigenin have approximately 50% higher NAD+ levels, underscoring apigenin’s role in NAD+ metabolism. As CD38 activity naturally increases with age, accelerating NAD+ decline, apigenin offers a unique way to counteract this process. When paired with NAD+ precursors like NR or NMN, apigenin further optimizes NAD+ metabolism, providing additional support for cellular health and vitality.*1-3 Provides antioxidant support to combat oxidative stress*Apigenin, like other powerful flavonoids such as quercetin, rutin, luteolin, and EGCG, offers robust antioxidant protection, helping plants combat UV radiation, environmental stress, and free radicals. In the human body, apigenin’s electron-rich flavonoid structure performs a similar protective function—neutralizing free radicals and boosting antioxidant pathways. This support helps promote cellular health, longevity, and overall resilience against oxidative damage.*4-7 Supports relaxation and sleep quality*Apigenin is well-known for its ability to support relaxation and sleep quality. Research shows that higher dietary apigenin intake is linked to better sleep quality. It works by activating chloride ion channels and modulating GABAergic pathways in the brain, helping to calm neuronal activity and induce a deeper state of relaxation. Additionally, apigenin plays a role in supporting healthy cortisol levels, reducing the impact of stress and encouraging balanced, restorative sleep patterns.*8-13 Targets key pathways of healthy aging at the cellular level*Beyond its role in maintaining NAD+ levels—and its downstream activation of sirtuins and PARPs—apigenin plays a crucial part in cellular renewal. It helps activate autophagy, the body's natural cellular repair process that maintains healthy cell function. Additionally, apigenin has been shown to combat cellular senescence by acting as a senolytic agent, aiding in the clearance of senescent cells while buffering the effects of senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) factors.*14,15 Beyond these core actions, apigenin influences numerous other longevity pathways, including AMPK, PPARα/γ, SIRT-1, mTOR, IGF-1, immune signaling, and NF-κB, helping to optimize cellular health across multiple systems.*16-29 New and noteworthyApigenin is highly active in the body, with emerging research highlighting its potential to provide a range of benefits, including neuroprotection, cardiovascular support, and metabolic health. Scientists are actively exploring its full therapeutic profile.*1

4371.description_text: Longevity ATP is a unique orally bioavailable form of ATP identical to the molecular form produced in the body, previously only available through injections or IV drips. Using the patented PeakATP ® formula to deliver a clinically studied dose of potent energy into your cells, infusing tissues with greater capacity to do more. Longevity ATP can help you to feel your best in the gym or in the boardroom, since it can support muscle strength and energy as well as cognitive performance.ATP, or Adenosine Triphosphate, is the cellular energy currency that fuels every activity within your body. From supporting cellular repair, to powering cognitive function, ATP is indispensable. Unfortunately, as we age, the natural production of ATP declines. This reduction not only impacts energy levels but contributes to cellular aging itself. Addressing ATP decline is key to maintaining vitality and mitigating the negative effects associated with unhealthy aging. View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Youthful Cellular EnergyAs we age, the body’s ability to produce and maintain optimal levels of ATP declines. This reduction in ATP levels can lead to decreased cellular energy, impacting various bodily functions.Supplementing with Longevity ATP may help to boost ATP levels in cells, thereby enhancing overall energy metabolism. This can be particularly beneficial for older adults who often experience a natural decline in energy levels. Cellular RepairATP is not only a source of energy but also plays a role in cellular repair and maintenance processes.Replenishing youthful ATP levels may support the body’s natural repair mechanisms, which could be beneficial in countering age-related cellular damage. Studies show that intracellular ATP administration contributes to rapid tissue regeneration to repair damaged cells. (1) Cognitive ProtectionBrain function is energy-intensive, and sufficient ATP is vital for maintaining cognitive health. Aging can impact brain energy metabolism, potentially leading to cognitive decline.By boosting ATP levels, Longevity ATP may help in supporting cognitive functions such as memory, focus, and overall brain health in older adults. A 2023 study confirmed that supplementing with ATP improves reaction time and overall cognitive function following exercise. (2) Protection Against Loss of Muscle Mass and StrengthAging is associated with a loss of muscle mass and strength. This loss can affect mobility, balance, and overall quality of life. As muscle mass decreases, risk of falls and bone fractures increases, which drastically impacts healthspan.Longevity ATP supplementation may support muscle health by improving blood flow and nutrient delivery to muscle tissues, potentially aiding in muscle growth and strength. A 12-week study found that supplementing with 400 mg of ATP daily resulted in increases of 12.9% and 16.4% for squat and deadlift, respectively. (3) Cardiovascular Health Adequate ATP levels are crucial for heart function. Longevity ATP may support cardiovascular health by improving blood flow and vascular function. Research shows that supplementing with ATP results in vasodilation and greater blood flow, enhancing nutrient and oxygen delivery, both critical to promoting healthy heart aging. (4)Enhanced ATP levels can also support the heart muscle’s energy needs, which is especially important as the efficiency of the cardiovascular system declines with age. Research shows that ergothioneine supports longevity by protecting against accelerated telomere shortening. (1) Longer telomeres are a powerful predictor of increased lifespan and healthspan. High levels of oxidative stress may contribute to DNA damage, a decline in ATP (cellular energy) production and elevated inflammatory markers. (5) Promotes Heart Health. By reducing oxidative stress, ergothioneine exhibits powerful cardioprotective properties. Oxidative stress is associated with accelerated aging of heart cells, studies show ergothioneine reduces cardiac-related mortality risk. (6) Enhances Brain Health. As you age, levels of ergothioneine decline in the body, potentially contributing to a decline in cellular, brain, heart, and muscle health. Ergothioneine is absorbed in the small intestine and transported throughout the body via a specific transporter known as the Organic Cation Transporter 1 (OCTN1). This transporter is highly selective for ergothioneine, allowing it to enter cells efficiently. Once inside the cells, ergothioneine primarily exerts its effects as a potent antioxidant. It works by donating electrons to neutralize harmful free radicals and reactive oxygen species (ROS) that are generated during normal cellular metabolism and in response to environmental stressors. Administration of ergothioneine in animal studies has been shown to reduce oxidative stress, mediate inflammatory markers, and promote cellular, brain, and heart health. Collagen supplementation has been shown to support skin health to improve signs of aging, such as wrinkles and decreased puffiness. 1 Provides Support to Bones and Joints. As you age, losing too much bone mass can increase your risk of fractures. Collagen offers protection from bone loss and supports healthy bones and joints to allow you to move more freely and painlessly. It also has been shown to have a positive effect on managing joint pain.2,3 Improves Digestion. One of the amino acids found in collagen, glycine, can help improve digestion by increasing stomach acid. The increased production of stomach acid allows for better digestion, helps prevent acid reflux and may even help restore gut health. Supports Organ and Tissues. Decreased collagen production leads to less support around key bodily processes, including tissue repair and heart health. Reduced tissue repair can be seen in fine lines and wrinkles, but can also contribute to deeper issues, such as delayed wound healing. Collagen has been shown to support heart health blood markers and support healthy wound healing.4 Helps Balance Blood Sugar. Marine collagen is typically high in glycine, which positively supports insulin and blood sugar management.5 Muscle loss is a common occurrence with aging. J Chiropr Med. 2013;12(1):20-25. doi:10.1016/j.jcm.2012.11.001 doi:10.1016/j.jcm.2012.11.001 Trimethylglycine (TMG), also known as betaine anhydrous, is an amino acid that supports the body's methylation processes. Methylation is a fundamental biochemical process in which one carbon atom and three hydrogen atoms (CH3) are transferred from one molecule to another. Methylation is responsible for numerous important bodily functions, such as cell division, cellular energy production, clearing histamine, metabolism, DNA expression (epigenetics), forming neurotransmitters and producing free radical-scavenging antioxidants. Our bodies contain a “methyl pool” of CH3 that is available whenever needed. As long as we have enough methyl groups stored in the pool, methylation typically is not a problem. However, there are a couple of things that may contribute to the depletion of the body's methyl pool. MTHFR Variants - Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) is a gene with common mutations that can interfere with the methylation process, causing high levels of homocysteine (a known risk factor in heart health conditions) in the blood and low folate levels. Up to 40% of the population may have one or both genetic mutations. Aging and Epigenetics - Methylation of DNA plays a crucial role in epigenetics, switching different sequences of your genetic material on and off as needed. The body's methylation ability and subsequent DNA expression are known to decline with age. Anti-aging researchers think these changes in DNA expression may be a contributing factor to many age-related diseases. NMN Supplementation and Methylation Support. When taken as a supplement, NMN may require the use of methyl groups to help facilitate the conversion of NAD+ in your cells, thereby activating sirtuin genes and promoting longevity. Although there is currently no evidence suggesting NMN’s natural methylation process depletes the methyl pool, many top anti-aging experts suggest that safeguarding against methyl depletion may be a wise proactive step to augment your NMN intake. 4384.description_text: In today's fast-paced world, achieving optimal health often feels like a challenge. The Prolon® 5-Day Fasting Nutrition Program offers a scientifically-backed solution that simplifies your journey. Designed by Dr. Valter Longo, a leading expert in longevity and gerontology, this innovative program combines the benefits of fasting with the nourishment your body needs to thrive. Through a carefully curated selection of plant-based foods, Prolon® activates your body’s natural fasting mode, promoting cellular rejuvenation, enhanced metabolism, and a balanced emotional state—all without the stress of traditional fasting. Whether you seek to boost your vitality, support healthy aging, or kickstart a new wellness routine, Prolon® provides a transformative experience in just five days. Product highlights Designed to mimic the benefits of intermittent fasting (IF) or prolonged water fasting Discovered and developed at the Longevity Institute of the University of Southern California Over 20 years and $36 million invested in research & development Scientifically tested by 18 global universities Clinically proven outcomes Long-term, lasting results Studied health benefits Fasting Mimicking Diets (FMDs) like Prolon® have been studied extensively in clinical research for years. One study reported a reduction in biological age by approximately 2.5 years.1 Other studies have shown improvements in: Systemic health Hallmarks of aging, including cellular senescence and autophagy Body composition, ketogenesis, and fat burning Blood sugar markers Cognitive performance, memory, and learning Energy, clarity, and well-being Skin hydration and glow1-6 What's in the meal kit? This kit contains a 5-day supply of the Prolon® Fasting Nutrition Program. Eat and drink the food as instructed for five continuous days. No other food should be consumed during the 5-day period. Unlimited amounts of water and herbal teas are allowed. Prolon® is a 5-day meal program providing about 1150 calories on Day 1 and approximately 800 calories on Days 2-5. Studies show that a very low-calorie diet (VLCD) of 800 calories per day can mimic important aspects of fasting and may offer similar benefits. Prolon® consists of proprietary plant-based soups, bars, drinks, snacks, teas and supplements – all designed to maximize the protective effects related to fasting, while providing micronutrient nourishment and minimizing hunger and the burdens of fasting. The program covers a period of five continuous days. Fasting diets like Prolon® activate autophagy, a natural process where cells break down and eliminate old proteins and other unwanted substances. During periods of reduced nutrient intake, these breakdown products are repurposed as fuel, helping to sustain the body and in the process promote cellular renewal. Fasting diets like Prolon® primarily support three key nutrient-sensing pathways: IGF-1, mTOR, and PKA. PKA responds mainly to sugars and carbohydrates, IGF-1 to protein (especially animal protein), and mTOR to IGF-1 and amino acids. These pathways interact to support cell growth and initiate a stress-resistant fasting state. Considerations The Prolon® meal kit contains products with soy, nuts, celery, oats, and sesame and should not be used if you have allergies to any of these ingredients. Although fasting is safe for most people, you should talk to your healthcare provider before beginning any diet or diet program to ensure it is safe and right for you. If you are underweight, have an eating disorder, have a pre-existing health condition or are taking any prescription medications, consult your healthcare provider before starting a fast. It’s best to avoid strenuous exercise during the 5-day program. References: 1. Brandhorst S et al. Nat Commun. 2024;15(1):1309. 2. Wei M et al. Sci Transl Med. 2017;9(377). 3. Brandhorst S et al. Cell Metab. 2015;22(1):86-99. 4. Choi IY et al. Cell Rep. 2016;15(10):2136-2146. 5. Rangan P et al. Cell Rep. 2022;40(13):111417. 6. Mishra A et al. Nat Metab. 2021;3(10):1342-1356. Soups: Minestrone, Tomato, Chickpea & Leeks, Carrot Ginger, Red Bell Pepper & Onion, Lentil Curry, and Green Pea & Chives. Fasting Bars: Nuts & Honey, Chocolate Chip, and Coconut Macadamia. Fasting Shake: Vanilla. Snacks: L-Bar (proprietary nut-based bar), L-Bar (proprietary choco crisp bar), Kale Crackers, Almond & Kale Crackers, Olives with Herbs, and Olives with Sea Salt. Drinks: L-Drink (tropical berry flavor), L-Drink (orange flavor), Herbal Teas (hibiscus, spearmint, spearmint lemon). Supplements: NR-1 (vegetable powder with vitamins & minerals supplement), Algal Oil, and Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

4388.description_text: Glycine is an amino acid that supports the central nervous system and sleep quality. It is considered a conditionally essential amino acid–this means our bodies produce glycine, but often not enough to meet our needs. Glycine is an important precursor for many critical molecules, including glutathione, the body’s master antioxidant. Glycine can help support: Improved sleep quality and duration* Healthy neurological function* Healthy aging and glutathione production* View Certificate of Analysis Supports healthy sleep quality. Certain cells in the central nervous system contain glycine receptors. Glycine is thought to influence intracellular ion communication and may act as an inhibitory neurotransmitter to help calm the nervous system. Additionally, glycine may also support sleep quality by helping to reduce core body temperature. Lowered nighttime core body temperature has been associated with healthy sleep patterns.* Clinical studies involving glycine supplementation have reported improvements in sleep quality and feelings of next day energy and mental clarity.* Supports neurological health. Age-related declines in memory and learning have been associated with changes in the NMDA receptor system. NMDA receptors are a group of ion channels that support memory and synaptic plasticity. Glycine may help support biochemical pathways related to the NMDA receptor system.* Supports healthy aging and glutathione production. Increased oxidative stress is a hallmark of aging. As we age, glutathione (our body’s master antioxidant) decreases over time. Glycine, as a building block of glutathione, can help optimize glutathione production. A clinical study involving supplementation with glycine and N-acetyl cysteine (another glutathione precursor) observed improvements in glutathione levels and several aging hallmarks.* Preclinical evidence suggests that glycine may also act as an autophagy activator and help clear methionine from the body, two important roles in supporting longevity.* References: Aguayo-Cerón KA et al. Biomed Pharmacother Biomedecine Pharmacother. 2023;165:115022. Razak MA et al. Oxid Med Cell Longev. 2017;2017:1-8. Yamadera et al. 4389.description_text: Your body loses its antioxidative defenses during aging. Yet, many age-related changes (the ones that none of us want to see) are often a direct or indirect result of oxidative stress. N-acetyl cysteine (NAC) is a backbone molecule for glutathione, the body’s “master antioxidant.” NAC may also support clearance of toxins to help the body maintain optimal functioning and performance.* View Certificate of Analysis Benefits: Resists oxidative stress* Supports immune, bronchial and respiratory health* Supports liver health and detoxification* Supports exercise performance* Resists oxidative stress. NAC exhibits direct activity on certain reactive oxygen and nitrogen species due to its unique molecular structure. It also works to help increase intracellular cysteine for the maintenance of glutathione homeostasis. A systematic review and meta-analysis of trials involving NAC supplementation reported significant increases in antioxidant markers including glutathione, catalase, and Total Antioxidant Capacity. Research suggests that NAC paired with glycine, another building block for glutathione, may provide optimal protection from free radicals.* Supports immune, bronchial and respiratory health. NAC can help modulate critical pathways for an optimal immune response. It can also maintain and support normal physiological levels of mucus in the sinus and respiratory system of health individuals.* Supports liver health and detoxification. NAC supports the body’s ability to excrete toxins through detoxification pathways by boosting glutathione production. NAC is a source of cysteine, an amino acid precursor for the synthesis of glutathione production. Glutathione is the body’s master antioxidant and plays a crucial role in liver health and detoxification.* Supports exercise performance. Clinical studies have reported improvements in exercise performance markers in the presence of NAC due to its ability to help maintain free radical balance and support a normal inflammatory response.* References: Tenório MCDS et al. Antioxidants (Basel). 2021;10(6):967.Fernández-Lázaro D et al. Nutrients. 2023;15(11):2463.Roes et al. Clin Chem Lab Med. 40(5):496–498. NAC helps support many of the hallmarks of aging through its support of free radical protection and glutathione synthesis. 4390.description_text: Collagen is the main structural component of skin and connective tissue, often described as the ‘glue’ that holds everything together. It accounts for almost a third of the body’s total protein. As we age, our bodies don’t produce as much collagen, and our skin, cartilage, and bones can become fragmented or depleted. ProHealth’s Pure Collagen Peptides is derived from bovine sources and contains a highly absorbable form of collagen. Bovine-derived collagen has a similar amino acid profile to human collagen, making it the optimal choice for supporting collagen renewal.* Benefits: Helps combat the visible signs of aging* Revitalizes skin, hair, and nails* Supports healthy bones and joints* Supports muscular strength and exercise recovery* Helps maintain optimal sleep efficiency* View Certificate of Analysis Helps combat the visible signs of aging. Collagen has been clinically studied for its support of skin appearance and hydration. A randomized, single-blind placebo-controlled trial involved 10 g daily of GelcoPEP® collagen peptides for 180 days. The collagen group experienced improvements in skin aesthetic criteria including hydration, elasticity, and appearance of lines and wrinkles. The strengthening of hair and nails was also reported in the collagen group.* Supports healthy aging and longevity. Collagen addresses many of the hallmarks of aging. Collagen peptides may help support cell communication and extracellular matrix signaling, which is crucial for tissue repair and regeneration. Collagen may also help support the function and longevity of progenitor cells in skin and connective tissues.* Supports healthy bones, joints and muscles. A 28-day clinical observational study involved GelcoPEP® collagen peptides in healthy individuals with complaints of joint discomfort. Improvements in muscle strength and range of motion were reported when compared with baseline.* Supports healthy sleep efficiency. Collagen peptides are a natural source of glycine, a clinically studied amino acid for supporting sleep quality and duration. A randomized placebo-controlled crossover study with 15 grams of bovine-sourced collagen peptides (3.5 grams of glycine) reported improvements in the frequency of awakenings during sleep and next-day cognitive function when compared to placebo.* References: 1. Bagalatela BS et al. HealthMED. 2024;18(1). 2. Lopes AP et al. HealthMED. 2018;12(3):132. 3. Thomas C et al. Eur J Nutr. 2024;63(1):323-335. 4394.description_text: Benefits: Introducing ProHealth Longevity's Vitamin B12, a unique combination crafted to harness the synergistic benefits of multiple forms of Vitamin B12. This innovative formula incorporates methylcobalamin, dibencozide, cyanocobalamin, and hydroxycobalamin, each selected for their unique contributions to cellular health, energy metabolism, and overall longevity. While many B12 supplements focus solely on one form of B12, ProHealth Longevity's Vitamin B12 embraces a comprehensive approach, recognizing the diverse roles and benefits offered by each variant. From supporting brain function to enhancing energy levels and combating age-related declines, our formula is designed to optimize B12 status and promote vitality at every stage of life. Plays a crucial role in maintaining cellular integrity by aiding in DNA synthesis and repair Acts as a cofactor in the conversion of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins into usable energy Supports healthy brain aging by aiding in the regeneration of myelin, the protective sheath around nerve fibers Provides mood support by serving as a cofactor in the synthesis of neurotransmitters View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Enhances cellular health. Vitamin B12 is a pivotal player in the synthesis and repair of DNA, critical processes that safeguard cellular integrity. Research has linked Vitamin B12 deficiency to disruptions in DNA synthesis and repair mechanisms, underscoring its importance in maintaining genetic stability. (1) Vitamin B12 offers further cellular protection by supporting telomere maintenance, the protective caps at the ends of chromosomes. Telomeres play a vital role in preserving DNA integrity during cell division, and their maintenance is closely linked to longevity and overall health. By supporting telomere integrity and DNA repair mechanisms, Vitamin B12 contributes to enhanced cellular resilience and longevity, offering comprehensive support for optimal aging. Heathy heart aging: Vitamin B12 aids in the reduction of homocysteine levels, an amino acid implicated in various forms of DNA damage, including DNA strand breaks. Elevated homocysteine is associated with accelerated cardiovascular aging and increased risk of cardiovascular events. (2) Research shows that increasing vitamin B12 intake may reduce homocysteine levels up to 7%. (3) Promotes energy production. Vitamin B12 is indispensable for sustaining energy levels, with its deficiency linked to reduced energy production in the body. Through its involvement in synthesizing SAMe, a vital methyl donor nutrient, Vitamin B12 supports mitochondrial function and the generation of ATP, the primary energy currency of cells. As we age, ATP production tends to decline, exacerbated by decreasing levels of Vitamin B12. This decline can lead to age-related fatigue and diminished stamina. Supplementation with Vitamin B12 may offer a solution by replenishing stores and potentially mitigating the decline in ATP production associated with aging. Promotes Cognitive Health. Vitamin B12 plays a crucial role in maintaining cognitive function, and its deficiency is strongly associated with cognitive decline and memory impairment. (4) Its diverse functions in methylation, neurotransmitter synthesis, and mitochondrial activity are essential for optimal brain health. Notably, Vitamin B12 shows promise in mitigating age-related neurodegeneration by regulating inflammatory processes and protecting against the formation of amyloid beta (Aβ) plaque. (5) Supplementation with Vitamin B12 has potential to alleviate symptoms linked to accelerated brain aging and support overall cognitive well-being. Supports Mood. Vitamin B12 plays a vital role in the synthesis of essential mood-regulating neurotransmitters, including serotonin and dopamine. Serotonin, known as the "feel-good" neurotransmitter, is synthesized from the amino acid tryptophan in a process facilitated by SAMe, which in turn relies on sufficient levels of Vitamin B12 for optimal function. Similarly, dopamine, a neurotransmitter linked to reward, pleasure, and motivation, also depends on Vitamin B12 for its synthesis. Scientific studies have demonstrated that deficiency in Vitamin B12 correlates with mood dysregulation, contributing to symptoms such as irritability and personality changes. (6) References: 1. 4396.description_text: Longevity ATP is a unique orally bioavailable form of ATP identical to the molecular form produced in the body, previously only available through injections or IV drips. Using the patented PeakATP ® formula to deliver a clinically studied dose of potent energy into your cells, infusing tissues with greater capacity to do more. Longevity ATP can help you to feel your best in the gym or in the boardroom, since it can support muscle strength and energy as well as cognitive performance.ATP, or Adenosine Triphosphate, is the cellular energy currency that fuels every activity within your body. From supporting cellular repair, to powering cognitive function, ATP is indispensable. Unfortunately, as we age, the natural production of ATP declines. This reduction not only impacts energy levels but contributes to cellular aging itself. Addressing ATP decline is key to maintaining vitality and mitigating the negative effects associated with unhealthy aging. View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Youthful Cellular EnergyAs we age, the body’s ability to produce and maintain optimal levels of ATP declines. This reduction in ATP levels can lead to decreased cellular energy, impacting various bodily functions.Supplementing with Longevity ATP may help to boost ATP levels in cells, thereby enhancing overall energy metabolism. This can be particularly beneficial for older adults who often experience a natural decline in energy levels. Cellular RepairATP is not only a source of energy but also plays a role in cellular repair and maintenance processes.Replenishing youthful ATP levels may support the body’s natural repair mechanisms, which could be beneficial in countering age-related cellular damage. Studies show that intracellular ATP administration contributes to rapid tissue regeneration to repair damaged cells. (1) Cognitive ProtectionBrain function is energy-intensive, and sufficient ATP is vital for maintaining cognitive health. Aging can impact brain energy metabolism, potentially leading to cognitive decline.By boosting ATP levels, Longevity ATP may help in supporting cognitive functions such as memory, focus, and overall brain health in older adults. A 2023 study confirmed that supplementing with ATP improves reaction time and overall cognitive function following exercise. (2) Protection Against Loss of Muscle Mass and StrengthAging is associated with a loss of muscle mass and strength. This loss can affect mobility, balance, and overall quality of life. As muscle mass decreases, risk of falls and bone fractures increases, which drastically impacts healthspan.Longevity ATP supplementation may support muscle health by improving blood flow and nutrient delivery to muscle tissues, potentially aiding in muscle growth and strength. A 12-week study found that supplementing with 400 mg of ATP daily resulted in increases of 12.9% and 16.4% for squat and deadlift, respectively. (3) Cardiovascular Health Adequate ATP levels are crucial for heart function. Longevity ATP may support cardiovascular health by improving blood flow and vascular function. Research shows that supplementing with ATP results in vasodilation and greater blood flow, enhancing nutrient and oxygen delivery, both critical to promoting healthy heart aging. (4)Enhanced ATP levels can also support the heart muscle’s energy needs, which is especially important as the efficiency of the cardiovascular system declines with age. Supporting energy maintenance of heart cells enhances overall heart function and promotes longevity.Faster Recovery and Relieves FatigueOlder adults may experience longer recovery times after physical activities and higher levels of fatigue. Longevity ATP can aid in faster recovery post-exercise and reduce feelings of fatigue. (5)This can encourage more consistent engagement in physical activities, which is essential for maintaining health and mobility in later years.Age-related Metabolic Decline Metabolic efficiency decreases with age, contributing to various age-related health issues including difficulties with regulating blood sugar, cholesterol levels, and weight.By supporting energy metabolism, Longevity ATP may help in maintaining metabolic health, an important metric for overall well-being in older age.In a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, healthy older adults who supplemented with ATP for 90 days who did not increase their activity level experienced significant body composition changes. On average, participants’ waist and hip circumferences each decreased by 3.05cm, and waist-to-hip ratio normalized by 0.02. (6) References: 1. Mo Y, Sarojini H, Wan R, et al. 4398.description_text: Alpha Lipoic Acid Alpha lipoic acid (ALA) is a powerful antioxidant that safeguards each of the cells in our body, supporting longevity by reducing oxidative stress and protecting against cellular damage. Research shows alpha lipoic acid protects against age-related health decline of the heart, brain and skin. Supports cellular health by reducing oxidative stress Promotes energy production by supporting mitochondrial health Normalizes blood sugar levels by improving insulin sensitivity Protects the heart from free radical damage Enhances cognitive health by protecting neurons from oxidative damage Improves skin health by aiding in collagen synthesis View Certificate of Analysis Research-Supported Benefits: Supports Cellular Health. Alpha lipoic acid (ALA) functions as a powerful antioxidant, protecting each of the cells in our body from oxidative damage. (1) Studies show that oxidative damage is a key contributor to age-related health decline and decreased longevity. (2) ALA further supports cellular health by aiding in mitochondrial biogenesis (the creation of new mitochondria), which is critical for ATP (cellular energy) production. (3) Regulates Blood Sugar. Research shows alpha lipoic acid exhibits blood-sugar regulating effects by increasing the uptake of glucose into cells and increasing insulin sensitivity. (4) A 2022 meta-analysis of 16 randomized controlled trials concluded alpha lipoic acid supplementation significantly reduces fasting blood glucose and Hemoglobin A1C. (5) Enhances Heart Health. By reducing oxidative stress, alpha lipoic acid offers protection against age-related decline of heart health. A 2022 randomized controlled trial involving 46 participants found that 12 weeks of alpha lipoic acid supplementation offers additional cardio-protection by significantly reducing triglycerides and total cholesterol. (6) Promotes Cognitive Health. Research shows that oxidative stress contributes to many of the symptoms of brain aging, including cognitive dysfunction and reduced memory. (7) Animal studies indicate alpha lipoic acid has neuroprotective effects by reducing markers of oxidative stress in the brain. (8) Improves Skin Health. A key contributor to skin aging is the decline in collagen production that occurs after age 40. Alpha lipoic acid supports healthy collagen synthesis by aiding in the recycling of vitamin C, which is a critical nutrient that promotes collagen production within the body. The antioxidant effects of alpha lipoic acid offer further support for skin health by protecting against oxidative damage of skin cells from environmental factors. References: 1. 4399.description_text: Helps combat aging, improves heart health and promotes muscle strength NMN supplementation has been found to improve various parameters of health, including physical endurance and muscle strength, neurological function, heart health, body weight and gene expression. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is a derivative of the B-vitamin niacin that dramatically improves health and longevity by serving as a precursor to NAD+. NMN Pro Powder allows NMN to be absorbed directly into the blood vessels in the mouth and under the tongue, which increases the product's bioavailability. In this way, NMN avoids digestion in the gastrointestinal tract and can be more rapidly delivered into the bloodstream. View Certificate of Analysis » Supports Longevity. Studies have shown that boosting NAD+ synthesis in the body extends the lifespan of yeast, worms and flies. (1) Blood Sugar Regulation. As we age, we have more trouble processing glucose, leading to higher blood sugar. Supplemental NMN is shown to improve several markers of skeletal muscle glucose metabolism that are commonly dysregulated in people with metabolic disorders. (2) Supports Metabolism and Healthy Weight. Although excessive body weight can develop at any age, adults over age 40 are particularly susceptible to age-related weight gain as metabolism slows down and body composition is altered to favor fat over lean muscle. As obese individuals have reductions in both NAD+ levels and ATP (energy) production, replenishing NAD+ through NMN can help to reverse this while improving metabolic pathways to maintain a healthy weight. (3,4,5) Supports Healthy Cognition: Declining cognitive function with age is related to a reduced NAD+ levels that impair mitochondrial function. Replenishing NAD+ stores through NMN may be able to prevent this dysfunction. (6,7) Supports Healthy Skin: In our 30s and 40s, the appearance of our skin can start to show signs of age. Several studies have examined how boosting NAD+ levels in the skin prevents premature skin aging or supports a healthier external appearance. (8,9) References: 1. Muscle mass tends to decrease with age, resulting in decreased strength and musculoskeletal health. Research shows supplementing with creatine increases muscle mass of aging muscle and may reduce risk of falls. (1) Enhances Cognitive Function. Brain aging commonly results in decreased cognitive capabilities, including reduced memory and recall ability. A 2023 review of randomized controlled trials showed that creatine supplementation improves number recall, spatial recall, and long-term memory in participants between the ages of 68-85. (2) Promotes Cellular Energy Production. Creatine supplementation enhances the production of ATP, the energy currency of our cells. Maintaining healthy ATP production is critical to promote healthy aging and longevity. Improves Fitness Performance. Studies have consistently demonstrated that creatine supplementation can improve performance in activities requiring short bursts of intense effort, such as weightlifting, sprinting, and high-intensity interval training. (3) This enhancement is attributed to creatine's ability to increase the body's store of phosphocreatine, a quick energy source for muscles, leading to improved strength, power, and endurance during high-intensity exercises. Published 2021 Jun 2. doi:10.3390/nu13061915 Creatine is a substance produced naturally in the body and found in moderate amounts in animal foods such as meat and fish. Aging is correlated with a decrease in creatine levels, which may contribute to a decline of muscle mass, cognitive function, and energy levels. A significant portion of creatine in the body is stored as phosphocreatine. Phosphocreatine supplies, recycles and buffers energy, making it instantly available when needed. By providing readily available energy for high-intensity workouts, creatine allows individuals to lift heavier weights and perform more repetitions during resistance training. This increased training intensity can stimulate greater muscle growth. Creatine’s supportive effect on ATP levels enhances cognitive function, improving memory in scientific studies. Creatine aids in muscle repair due to its ability to increase muscle protein synthesis, which is especially critical for reducing age-related muscle loss.
